info.+content: Tsuihо̄ Sareta Shо̄nin wa Kin no Chikara de Sekai wo Sukū
追放された商人は金の力で世界を救う

With no hero to save the world, perhaps money is the answer. Trao may be a member of the S-rank adventurer party Blue Ring, but as a merchant, he doesn't have much to offer when it comes to combat. So when his comrades learn he's been dipping into the party's funds, they kick him out without a second thought. With nowhere else to go, Trao decides to follow the money—more specifically, the funds he's been redirecting to the all-female party Garnet. His goal. To take down the Demon King. But this journey is off to a less-than-heroic start, as his new comrades' first order of business is looting the corpses of Trao's former party. With the Demon King's invasion threatening to engulf the world, this pragmatic merchant might just be the unlikely answer to humanity's prayers. After all, saving the world is just another business opportunity. (from manga)
